quests.instruction: Which letter is missing? S, T, U, __, W
quests.hint: Look at the letter before the blank, U. What comes after it?
quests.explanation: The full line is S, T, U, V, W, so the missing letter is V.
quests.funFact: V is the Roman numeral for 5.

quests.instruction: What comes after y?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song up to y. What letter comes next?
quests.explanation: z comes right after y. In the alphabet: y, z.
quests.funFact: Zebra, zero and zoo all begin with Z.

quests.instruction: Which letter is latest in the alphabet: V, A or Z?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and see which of these letters you reach last.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order these go A, V, Z, so Z comes last.
quests.funFact: Capital Z is a zig-zag.

quests.instruction: Which letter belongs between m and o?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song slowly and listen for the gap.
quests.explanation: n sits between m and o.
quests.funFact: Nose, nut and net all begin with N.

quests.instruction: Which row goes in order when you sing the alphabet? (4 capital letters)
quests.hint: Compare the first letters of the rows. A row that starts with a later letter cannot be in order.
quests.explanation: L, O, R, S is in alphabet order: each letter comes after the one before it.
quests.funFact: Double l, as in ball, bell and doll, still says one 'lll' sound.

quests.instruction: Complete the line: __, l, m, n, o
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song quietly and stop at the gap.
quests.explanation: k completes the line: k, l, m, n, o.
quests.funFact: Capital K is a tall line with two arms that meet it in the middle.

quests.instruction: What letter goes in the blank? __, F, G, H, I
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song quietly and stop at the gap.
quests.explanation: E completes the line: E, F, G, H, I.
quests.funFact: Capital E has one long line and three arms pointing right.

quests.instruction: Which letter do you sing right before M?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop just before M. Which letter did you sing last?
quests.explanation: In alphabet order you say K, L, M, so L is the one before M.
quests.funFact: L is letter number 12 of the 26 letters, with 11 letters before it and 14 after it.

quests.instruction: Which small letter is the partner of J?
quests.hint: Imagine writing Jeans in small letters. What is its first letter?
quests.explanation: J and j are two forms of the same letter, named 'jay'.
quests.funFact: The words uppercase and lowercase come from old printing shops, where capital letters were kept in the upper drawer.

quests.instruction: Which group of 4 capital letters is in alphabet order?
quests.hint: Check each row: does every letter come after the one before it?
quests.explanation: K, L, M, S is in alphabet order: each letter comes after the one before it.
quests.funFact: A kangaroo and a koala both begin with K, and both live in Australia.

quests.instruction: One letter is hiding. Which one? c, d, e, __, g
quests.hint: Say the letters in order, starting at c. Which letter is needed at the blank?
quests.explanation: The full line is c, d, e, f, g, so the missing letter is f.
quests.funFact: F is letter number 6 of the 26 letters, with 5 letters before it and 20 after it.

quests.instruction: Which letter sits exactly in the middle of b, c, d, e, f?
quests.hint: Count the letters, then count in from each end.
quests.explanation: d is in the middle: there are 2 letters on each side.
quests.funFact: D says 'duh'. Your tongue taps the roof of your mouth just behind your teeth.

quests.instruction: Which comes last in the alphabet: q, d or a?
quests.hint: Think of A at the start and Z at the end. Which letter is closest to that end?
quests.explanation: In alphabet order these go a, d, q, so q comes last.
quests.funFact: Q is almost always followed by u in English words, like queen and quick.

quests.instruction: One letter is hiding. Which one? f, g, __, i, j, k
quests.hint: Look at the letter before the blank, g. What comes after it?
quests.explanation: h completes the line: f, g, h, i, j, k.
quests.funFact: H is called 'aitch' in most English-speaking places.

quests.instruction: What letter sits between b and d in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song slowly and listen for the gap.
quests.explanation: c sits between b and d.
quests.funFact: C and K can make the same 'kuh' sound, as in cat and kite.

quests.instruction: Look at this line of letters: h, i, j, k, l. Which letter is in the middle?
quests.hint: The middle letter has the same number of letters on its left and on its right.
quests.explanation: j is in the middle: there are 2 letters on each side.
quests.funFact: J says 'juh', as in jam, jump and jet.

quests.instruction: Which row of 4 capital letters is in alphabet order?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song. In which row do the letters come in the same order?
quests.explanation: O, P, S, W is in alphabet order: each letter comes after the one before it.
quests.funFact: Capital O and lowercase o are both round, so they look very much alike.

quests.instruction: Which letter is missing? m, __, o, p, q, r
quests.hint: The blank is letter number 2 in a line of 6. Say the line from the start and stop there.
quests.explanation: The full line is m, n, o, p, q, r, so the missing letter is n.
quests.funFact: In autumn, the last n is silent.

quests.instruction: What letter goes in the blank? G, H, I, __, K, L
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song quietly and stop at the gap.
quests.explanation: The full line is G, H, I, J, K, L, so the missing letter is J.
quests.funFact: J is one of the youngest letters. It began as a fancy way to write I.

quests.instruction: Which letter comes right after a in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Say the letters in order from the start until you pass the one you need.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order you say a, b, c, so b is the one after a.
quests.funFact: To say 'buh', press your lips together and let a little puff of air out.

quests.instruction: Find the small letter that begins the word Dog.
quests.hint: Think about how Dog begins when you write it down.
quests.explanation: The first letter of Dog is d. Its shape: a round tummy on the left with a tall stick on the right.
quests.funFact: D says 'duh'. Your tongue taps the roof of your mouth just behind your teeth.

quests.instruction: Only one row of 4 small letters goes in alphabet order. Which one?
quests.hint: Compare the first letters of the rows. A row that starts with a later letter cannot be in order.
quests.explanation: j, o, p, s is in alphabet order: each letter comes after the one before it.
quests.funFact: The names Jay and Jack both begin with J.

quests.instruction: Which letter fits in the middle: n, __, p?
quests.hint: Say the alphabet from n. The next letter before p is the one.
quests.explanation: The order is n, o, p.
quests.funFact: Capital O and Q look alike, but Q has a little tail.

quests.instruction: Complete the line: G, __, I, J, K, L
quests.hint: Look at the letter before the blank, G. What comes after it?
quests.explanation: H completes the line: G, H, I, J, K, L.
quests.funFact: Capital H looks like two tall lines joined by a bridge.

quests.instruction: Look at this line of letters: l, m, n, o, p. Which letter is in the middle?
quests.hint: The middle letter has the same number of letters on its left and on its right.
quests.explanation: n is in the middle: there are 2 letters on each side.
quests.funFact: In knee and knot, the k is silent, so the word begins with an 'nnn' sound.

quests.instruction: Fill the gap in the alphabet line: A, B, C, D, __, F
quests.hint: Say the letters in order, starting at A. Which letter is needed at the blank?
quests.explanation: The full line is A, B, C, D, E, F, so the missing letter is E.
quests.funFact: Elephant, egg and elf begin with the short e sound.

quests.instruction: Sing the alphabet. Which do you sing last: E, U or Q?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and see which of these letters you reach last.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order these go E, Q, U, so U comes last.
quests.funFact: Umbrella, up and uncle begin with the short u sound.

quests.instruction: Which group of 4 small letters is in alphabet order?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song. In which row do the letters come in the same order?
quests.explanation: m, p, t, u is in alphabet order: each letter comes after the one before it.
quests.funFact: Capital M and W are upside-down versions of each other.

quests.instruction: Fill the gap in the alphabet line: g, h, i, j, k, __
quests.hint: The blank is letter number 6 in a line of 6. Say the line from the start and stop there.
quests.explanation: l completes the line: g, h, i, j, k, l.
quests.funFact: Capital L looks like a stick with a foot.

quests.instruction: What letter comes just before H?
quests.hint: The letter before H comes just after F.
quests.explanation: G comes right before H. In the alphabet: F, G, H.
quests.funFact: Hard G says 'guh', as in goat, gift and guitar.
